summary_1line: Rama and Lakshmana depart Ayodhya with Vishwamitra, receive blessings, and Rama is initiated into the powerful knowledge of Bala and Atibala by the Sarayu.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Dasaratha embraces and smells the heads of Rama and Lakshmana before entrusting them to the sage Vishwamitra.
Rama and Lakshmana, bows in hand and quivers on their backs, follow the austere sage Vishwamitra as celestial beings shower flowers from the sky.
By the river Sarayu, Rama pours water over himself while Vishwamitra prepares to teach him the secret sciences of Bala and Atibala.
